body:
Pink Calcite is a soft and soothing yet potent heart healer that opens you to a greater influx of self-love and self-compassion. Its swirling bands of light pink inspire peaceful reflection, connecting you with energy streams of universal love and emotional healing. Pink Calcite is all about love, but not necessarily the romantic kind — its energy goes much deeper, bathing us in pure, unrelenting love and compassion for ourselves. This gem reminds us that we know our own heartache best. Who, then, is better suited to soothe ourselves when we’re feeling down?

We often recommend Pink Calcite to those who have trouble treating themselves with kindness. We may have been raised to believe that softness is weakness and that we must be hard on ourselves to achieve success. Pink Calcite reminds us that life is easier and more enjoyable when you’re your own #1 supporter. This soothing heart chakra gem fosters self-love and self-healing, creating space for you to make your own well-being a priority.

If you feel drawn to Pink Calcite, it may be a sign you need to slow down and treat yourself to some much-needed TLC. When you need a break from life’s emotional hailstorms, this crystal’s cozy, nurturing energy provides the perfect place to cocoon yourself in for a bit.
